title: A World of Ice and Light
description: Photographer Christoph Johann was keen to explore the landscape of Alaska's Sheridan Glacier due to the way pockets of light shine through its extraordinary ice formations. Working with Points North Heli Adventures and skier Simon Hillis, he set out to capture some unexpected perspectives of the area. "Sometimes, the most incredible moments happen when you step off the beaten path and into another world," Johann tells National Geographic.
translated_description: 摄影师克里斯托夫·约翰很想探索阿拉斯加谢里登冰川的景观，因为光斑透过其非凡的冰层构造闪耀的方式令他着迷。他与Points North Heli Adventures和滑雪者西蒙·希利斯合作，开始捕捉该地区一些意想不到的视角。“有时候，最不可思议的时刻发生在你偏离常规路线、踏入另一个世界的时候，”约翰告诉《国家地理》。
